subject.title: Skill path resolution rejects Nix-managed symlinks — goplaces skipped

question: Should nix-openclaw continue exposing Nix-managed skills as workspace symlinks when the package also configures their real directories through `skills.load.extraDirs`?
rationale: Source evidence establishes the symlink/root mismatch but not whether the workspace links are an intentional user-facing discovery surface or redundant compatibility wiring; that packaging contract needs maintainer intent before changing it.

options.title: Verify then simplify
options.body: Recommended: obtain a current runtime inventory and remove or avoid only the redundant workspace-link path if the real Nix directories already load correctly.

options.title: Preserve workspace links
options.body: Keep the links and design a narrowly constrained trusted-path mechanism if maintainers require workspace-path discovery as a supported user-facing behavior.

recommendation.title: Verify then simplify
recommendation.body: Recommended: obtain a current runtime inventory and remove or avoid only the redundant workspace-link path if the real Nix directories already load correctly.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline provides the only concrete maintainer-routing signal for the affected packaging behavior.
